main.description: Part of a chunk list too long for the version record that holds it. The record key is the version's, a dash, and the part's number from 1 ("<version>-1", "<version>-2", ...). The version says how many parts there are, and holds no chunks itself; nor does a node whose contentsFrom is that version. The parts are written before or with the version, never changed, and deleted with it. The sealed payload is {chunkIDs}: the IDs that decrypt this part's chunks, in the same order.

chunks.description: This part of the contents, in encrypted chunks, in order. Readable so the PDS keeps the blobs while the record references them.

sealed.description: The chunks' IDs, sealed for this collection and record key.
